name: Two-Stage Meta (Ridge → LGBM)
description: Stage 1: Ridge (α=0.01) on [mean, std]; Stage 2: LGBM on [ridge_pred, mean, std]
notes: Two-stage meta shows dramatic improvement. All 7 targets improved by 0.25-0.45. However, expected LB of 0.968 is suspiciously high (worse than 0.622 baseline). This is because the two-stage uses CV for meta training while V534 uses full-data fit. The CV-bound metric is more honest but the actual submission LB will be determined by the file submission. The large gap values suggest the LGBM meta significantly improves calibration over linear Ridge.
